head: codex/111-wp18c01-conversation-session-preparation
title: [v0.92][WP-18C.01] Implement canonical human-agent conversation sessions
body:
Closes #111
Closes #113

## Summary
- add Runtime-owned bounded conversation sessions with recipient binding, deterministic turn ordering, idempotency, timeout, cancellation, and reconnect retrieval
- bind asynchronous results to the exact authentication generation and credential digest
- bound duplicate attachment handling and preserve newer attachments across stale completion races
- include the independently reviewed policy-filtered Runtime roster and exact agent-detail dependency previously staged in PR #222
- reconcile current main continuity functionality while preserving both startup paths
